# Up My Aura Barbershop

> Independent barber in NW Calgary. Precision cuts, skin fades, beard sculpting and hot towel shaves with Danny, in a private barber chair at the back of a salon at 3-936 Northmount Dr NW, Calgary, AB T2L 0B2.

Hours (from the website; check booking for current availability):
- Monday: Closed
- Tuesday: 12:00 – 8:30 PM
- Wednesday: Closed
- Thursday: 12:00 – 8:30 PM
- Friday: 12:00 – 8:00 PM
- Saturday & Sunday: Closed
